primer.title: Quantum Primer: What is a Qubit?
primer.subtitle: The fundamental difference between classical and quantum information
primer.step1Desc: A classical bit is like a light switch: it can ONLY be definitely 0 (OFF) or definitely 1 (ON).
primer.step2Desc: A quantum bit (qubit) can exist in a superposition of |0⟩ and |1⟩ at the same time: |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩. It lives anywhere on the surface of a 3D sphere (the Bloch Sphere) until measured!
primer.step3Desc: When you look at (measure) a qubit, its delicate superposition collapses into a definite classical 0 or 1 with probabilities |α|² and |β|².
primer.step4Desc: Two qubits can become linked so that measuring one instantly determines the state of the other, no matter the distance. Notice their individual Bloch vectors become undefined (mixed states)!

deutschJozsa.title: Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithm
deutschJozsa.summary: Determines whether a mystery black-box function is Constant or Balanced in a single quantum query, whereas classical computers require exponential evaluations.

grover.title: Grover's Search Algorithm
grover.summary: Finds a marked item in an unsorted database of N items with quadratic speedup (O(√N) vs classical O(N)) through phase inversion and diffusion.

teleportation.title: Quantum Teleportation
teleportation.summary: Transmits an unknown quantum state from Alice to Bob using 1 shared entangled Bell pair and 2 classical bits without violating the No-Cloning Theorem.

superdenseCoding.title: Superdense Coding
superdenseCoding.summary: Sends two classical bits of information (00, 01, 10, or 11) by physically transmitting only a single quantum qubit through an entangled channel.

qft.title: Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT)
qft.summary: Transforms computational basis amplitudes into frequency phase rotations with exponential speedup (O(n²) gates vs classical FFT O(n·2ⁿ)).

quantumPhaseEstimation.title: Quantum Phase Estimation
quantumPhaseEstimation.summary: Estimates the unknown phase eigenvalue θ of an arbitrary unitary operator U using controlled powers of U and an inverse QFT register.

shor.title: Shor's Factoring Algorithm
shor.summary: Breaks RSA encryption by reducing prime factorization to quantum modular order finding, solving in polynomial time what takes classical supercomputers billions of years.

vqe.title: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
vqe.summary: Finds molecular ground state energies on noisy quantum hardware via hybrid quantum parameterized ansatz state preparation and classical gradient descent.
